usedFor: OpnForm collects submissions and HubSpot keeps the contacts, so “New Submission Created” can feed “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission Created” in OpnForm, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each form entry becomes a contact in HubSpot with the properties you map.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so add an email field to the form.
